name: Panchmel Dal
ingredients: ½ cup mixed dals (toor, chana, moong, masoor and urad, about 2 tbsp each), rinsed and soaked 30 minutes
2½ cups water and ¼ tsp turmeric
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp panch phoran (or cumin, mustard, fennel), 2 dried red chillies, 2 garlic cloves, pinch of hing
steps: Pressure-cook the dals with turmeric, tomato and water for 4 whistles until soft.
Heat the oil for the tadka and crackle the spices; add the chillies, garlic and hing.
Pour the tadka into the dal, add garam masala and simmer for 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and coriander.
note: A Rajasthani classic that blends five dals for a broader amino-acid profile.
